placement.claim: A shared App Server review-result capability probably owns immutable ReviewResult and concern-scoped ReviewJudgment semantics; the review-episode service owns unfinished continuation state; domain evidence and finding services retain their existing meaning; and Codebase Memory supplies a replaceable generation-bound navigation projection.

reopening_conditions: Implementation dogfood shows that immutable result publication and unfinished episode continuation cannot remain separate without losing atomicity or recoverability.
A provider-neutral reviewer cannot emit concern-scoped judgments compactly without materially increasing inference cost or introducing ambiguous host expansion.
Stable concern identities cannot be versioned independently from provider profiles without duplicating or fragmenting review-contract ownership.
Real remediation shows that finding lineage and judgment succession require one canonical record rather than linked but distinct records.
Code-change evidence cannot nominate possibly affected judgments across rename, move, split, merge, deletion, and unresolved identity without manufacturing semantic invalidation.
Codebase Memory cannot preserve owner isolation, exact structural-generation binding, atomic projection publication, and truthful unresolved endpoints through a bounded extension.
A bounded paired evaluation shows that concern-scoped delta review reduces cost only by losing material adjudicated findings.
Privacy, confidentiality, retention, or deletion requirements make the proposed observed-activity and asserted-judgment separation insufficient.

authority.decision_owner: user or future explicitly authorized portfolio owner

relationships.rationale: Implementation-review and remediation evidence now distinguishes immutable published result and judgment meaning from unfinished episode continuation while preserving the earlier proposal's approved review-artifact consequences.
Concern-scoped judgments allow a coordinator to nominate bounded affected perspectives and preserve explicit carried-forward coverage without making selection or synthesis authoritative.
Exact physical and structural before-and-after observations can nominate judgments for relevance assessment, while the review-result capability retains semantic carry-forward authority.
Observed runtime activity may support but cannot manufacture reviewer assertions of inspection, reliance, or judgment.
Material revision-bound findings may be published through the production claim service while positive, incomplete, and uncertain review judgments remain review-domain meaning.
Both candidates require exact-revision reliance and selective reconsideration while preserving distinct domain owners; their projections may compose without forming a universal semantic registry.
Review judgments may rely on exact browser, structural, pixel, accessibility, geometry, or interaction evidence without absorbing capture or evidence-freshness ownership.
